name: Moroccan Lentil-Kale Salad with Apricots, Dates, Pistachios & Feta

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer, rinse lentils under cold water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan; add water and salt. Cover and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, remove lid, reduce heat to a simmer, and cook until tender, 15-20 minutes. Drain, rinse under cold water to cool, and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups green lentils, dried
6 cup water
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ oranges
3 bunches kale
9 sticks celery
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Juice oranges into a large bowl.
Peel and mince garlic and shallots. Add both to the bowl with the orange juice along with oil, vinegar, maple syrup, and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
2 shallots
¼ cup extra virgin olive oil
2 tbsp red wine vinegar
1 tbsp pure maple syrup
1 ½ tsp cumin, ground
¾ tsp cinnamon, ground
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
½ tsp cloves, ground

instructions.primary_message: Fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems; cut leaves crosswise into thin (shred-like) pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing. Using your hands, massage kale with the dressing until wilted, 1-2 minutes.
Trim and thinly slice celery crosswise. Add to the bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Roughly chop pistachios, dates, and apricots. Add all three to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup pistachios, unsalted
¾ cup medjool dates, pitted
18 dried apricots

instructions.primary_message: When the lentils are done, add to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls. Top with feta and enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (113 g) pkgs crumbled feta cheese
